UserPromptSubmit.matcher: review PR|audit PR|fix review|PR review|review changes|code review

hooks.command:
echo '## TDD PR Audit Reminder

Before starting a reactive review, check if this PR qualifies for a TDD audit:
- >= 5 changed files
- Security-sensitive code (RLS, auth, validation)
- >= 1 prior review round
- Cross-module changes (types, helpers, DB schema)

If ANY condition is met, use the TDD PR Audit protocol:
  Protocol: strug-standards/standards/tdd-pr-audit.md
  Prompt: strug-standards/prompts/tdd-pr-audit.prompt.md

Key principle: Write failing tests BEFORE implementing fixes. Every fix must have a test.'

node -e "const cp=require('child_process'),path=require('path'),fs=require('fs');const m=cp.execSync('git worktree list --porcelain',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim().split(/\r?\n/)[0].replace('worktree ','').trim();var d=m,h;while(d){var c=path.join(d,'..','strug-standards','scripts','hook-run.js');if(fs.existsSync(c)){h=c;break;}var p=path.dirname(d);if(p===d)break;d=p;}if(h)require(h);" check-main-worktree.js

node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');try{const r=cp.execSync('git rev-parse --show-toplevel',{encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).trim();const f=path.join(r,'.claude/session-branch');if(!fs.existsSync(f)){const b=cp.execSync('git branch --show-current',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();if(b&&b!=='main'){fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(f),{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(f,b);}}}catch(e){process.stderr.write('[session-branch] WARNING: '+e.message+'\\n');}"
